snippet.title: Grimoji Beta Trailer
snippet.description:
This is my first time editing a video, so don't be too hard on me :)

Grimoji is a game inspired by classics like 2048, Suika, and Candy Crush.

It aims to be innovative and entertaining.

For more info, visit: https://grimoji.io/
